how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through the LAHDC-KSSRB online portal from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026. Applications sent by post, by hand, by mail or by any other means will be summarily rejected.

Open the portal www.dssrbkargil.in and click the "New User Registration" link for one-time registration. Use your own mobile number and a valid, active personal e-mail ID, and keep both active during the recruitment cycle.

Fill in the basic and contact details and upload a scanned passport-size photograph and signature in JPEG format. The notice's application section allows 20 KB to 100 KB, while its instructions to candidates say 20 KB to 50 KB. The photograph should be about 3.5 cm (width) x 4.5 cm (height) and no more than three months old, with the face covering about 40% of the area (samples in Annexure-XV(A)).
Log in with the user ID and password sent to your registered e-mail. Check the advertisements and click "Apply Now" against the post.

Fill in the application. Write your name, father's name and date of birth exactly as in the Matriculation/Secondary certificate. Apply separately for each category of post, and submit only one application per category of post.
Pay the fee online (₹250 Unreserved, ₹200 other categories) by 27 November 2026.
Read the declaration at the end of the form, then submit. The application is then accepted provisionally, and no corrections are allowed after final submission.
Print the application form. You do not send it to the Board. A duly signed printed copy must be produced, with self-attested documents, at the scrutiny or Document Verification stage.

content_sections.heading: About LAHDC-KSSRB
content_sections.text: The Kargil Subordinate Service Recruitment Board works under the Office of the Secretary, Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council, Kargil, in the Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. Its job is to select candidates and recommend them to departments, based on the vacancies those departments report. The departments, not the Board, decide the number of vacancies and the reservation roster. The Board's Chairman is the Deputy Commissioner/CEO, LAHDC, Kargil, and its e-mail address is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Department
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 181 posts across 20 items in six departments. Category-wise, there are 4 UR, 155 ST, 1 SC, 6 ALC and 15 EWS posts. The horizontal reservation is 5 posts for PwD, 8 for ESM and 5 for OSP. Most of the posts are in the School Education Department (107 posts, 70 of them Class-IV). The Ladakh Power Development Department has the next largest share (47 posts, 45 of them Technician-III). The other departments have 13 posts (Animal Husbandry), 8 (Rural Development Department & PR), 5 (PHE/I&FC) and 1 (Handicraft). Vertical reservation is for Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Actual Line of Control (ALC) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS). Horizontal reservation is 6% for Ex-Servicemen (ESM), 4% for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and 4% for Outstanding Sportsperson (OSP), vide S.O 247 dated 18.08.2026. The Indenting Departments decide and communicate where it applies. Reservation follows the Reservation Rules notified vide S.O 77 dated 27-06-2025 of the Social & Tribal Welfare Department, read with the Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025. A candidate eligible under more than one category (ST and ALC, ALC and EWS, or SC and ALC) must choose only ONE category in the online form, as per section-19 of the J&K Reservation Act, 2004. The choice cannot be changed after submission. Only candidates with a benchmark disability count as PwD. Their selection depends on the posts being identified as suitable for their category and on the vacancies the departments report. Sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen get no age relaxation or reservation and should not mark themselves as ex-servicemen. The number of vacancies comes from the departments. The Board is not responsible if a department withdraws or changes them.

content_sections.text: The candidate must be a resident of Kargil District, read as "Erstwhile District Kargil". This covers the whole area of Kargil district as it existed immediately before Notification S.O.180 dated 27-04-2026. The candidate must also hold a Domicile Certificate in the Annexure-V format (Form-B), issued by a Competent Authority under the Union territory of Ladakh Grant of Domicile Certificate under the Ladakh Civil Services Decentralization and Recruitment-Grant of Domicile Certificate (Procedure) Rules, 2025, and S.O 76 dated 27-06-2025. The essential qualification must be held by the crucial date of eligibility, 27 November 2026. Candidates still awaiting the result of the final examination on that date are NOT eligible and should not apply. Selection follows the Recruitment Rules of each post. Equivalency is not allowed unless the prescribed essential qualification mentions it. Where it is allowed, the candidate must submit the equivalence order or letter (with number and date) from the Government of India, a State Government or the Competent Authority. Without it, the application will be rejected. content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: A printed admit card, downloaded from the website (admit cards will not be sent by post) Two recent passport-size colour photographs A valid original photo ID, such as an Aadhaar Card or e-Aadhaar printout, Driving License, Voter Card, PAN Card, an identity card issued by a University/College/Government, an Employer ID Card, or any photo ID issued by the Central/State Government An additional original certificate proving date of birth, if the photo ID does not show it A signed printout of the online application form Self-attested copies of supporting documents, and original certificates A Domicile Certificate (Annexure-V), issued by the Tehsildar An SC certificate (Annexure-III), ST certificate (Annexure-IV) or ALC certificate (Annexure-XV), issued by the Tehsildar. The ALC certificate is valid for five years from the date of issue. An EWS Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure-XIII), issued by the District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/Sub-Divisional Magistrate/Tehsildar. It requires gross annual family income below Rs. 8 lakh. The family must not own 5 acres or more of agricultural land, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, a residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities, or 200 sq. yards or more elsewhere. A PwD certificate (Annexure-VI to IX), from the Members/Chairperson of the Medical Board and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital. It must be issued under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and the Union Territory of Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 181 vacancies across 20 post items in six departments. They include Class-IV (70), Technician-III (45), Laboratory Assistant (31), Attendant (9) and Library Assistant (5).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and to pay the fee online is 27 November 2026. Applications open on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: It depends on the post. Class-IV, Mirab, Store Khalasi and Attendant need Matriculation/Std. X pass. Junior Assistant needs graduation with a 200-hour or 6-month computer course and a typing speed of 35 words per minute. Technician-III needs a two-year NTC/STC in the relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18-40 years as on 1 January 2026. The upper limit is 45 years for SC/ST/ALC, 50 years for PwBD and 55 years for PwBD who are also SC/ST/ALC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: The notice gives pay levels, not amounts. Junior Assistant, Receptionist, Veterinary Pharmacist and other L-4 posts are at Level L-4. Laboratory Assistant, Technician-III and other L-2 posts are at Level L-2. Class-IV, Mirab, Bearer, Store Khalasi and Attendant are at Level SL-1.
